dict.string: Daily OK can attach your approximate location to a check-in so your family group knows you're in your usual area. This is optional — Daily OK works without it.

If you turn on Background Location, Daily OK will notify your family group when you arrive at or leave your usual area (significant location changes only). This is optional and you can turn it off at any time in Settings.
Daily OK uses notifications to deliver check-in reminders and to alert your family group if a check-in is missed. You can change notification settings at any time.

If you choose to share activity, Daily OK reads only your step count to show your family a simple “Active today” note. Your health data never leaves your phone — only the yes/no is shared. This is optional and you can turn it off any time.

Daily OK writes a “Active today” note derived from your step count when you share health data with your family group. No other health data is modified. This is optional and you can turn it off any time.
